newsitem.title: JAPAN: Rover to increase sales outlets in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Rover to increase sales outlets in Japan.

text.p: Rover Japan Ltd, the Japanese unit of the Rover Group, said on Tuesday it would open five new sales outlets in March.
The five will bring the number of its sales outlets to 123, a Rover Japan spokesman said.
The Rover Group is the British unit of Bayerische Motoren-Werke AG (BMW).
Rover Japan boosted its Japanese sales by 91 percent in January to 1,615 units.
Rover Japan plans to increase its sales outlets to as many as 140 by the end of December, the spokesman said.
In January, Rover Japan said it aimed to sell 30,000 cars in Japan in calendar 1997, up from last year's record of 27,254 cars.
